messages.content: Call me A
Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?

A... keeping it mysterious, i see

where you working these days?
Resigned recently looking for something new and exiciting

resigned recently... the plot thickens

what was your last company? need to know where you escaped from to figure out where you should land next
Accenture

accenture... ah, the consulting grind. at least you got out before they sucked your soul completely dry.

found someone on linkedin - flavio barreiros, md at accenture. this you? https://br.linkedin.com/in/flavio-barreiros
Nope

fair enough. "A" is pretty hard to search for...

can't find you on linkedin with just that. drop your linkedin url or send me your resume? need at least one to match you with roles that don't suck
https://www.linkedin.com/in/altafmallick?utm_source=share&utm_campaign=share_via&utm_content=profile&utm_medium=ios_app

altaf mallick... so "A" was just keeping it mysterious. i see you.

accenture to whatever's next... classic escape story. what made you finally pull the trigger and leave? the endless powerpoints finally get to you?
Manager and work both sucked

ah the classic accenture double whammy - terrible manager AND soul-crushing work. at least you're honest about it.

most people stay trapped for years complaining but never leaving. respect for actually doing something about it.

how long you been working total?
Nearly 4 years

4 years... solid foundation but not stuck in the comfort zone yet. good timing to make a move.

what kind of role you looking for next?
Related to nutanix

nutanix... hyper-converged infrastructure, virtualization, cloud platforms. that's some serious enterprise tech.

so you're looking at nutanix the company specifically, or roles working with nutanix technology? because that opens up a bunch of different paths - could be sales engineering, technical consulting, pre-sales, solutions architecture...

what's the nutanix angle for you?
To be precise Nutanix administration or Nutanix architecture

nutanix admin or architecture... now we're talking. proper technical roles, not more consulting bs.

makes sense after dealing with accenture's mess - you want to actually build and manage infrastructure instead of just talking about it in powerpoints.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Any update

yo i need at least linkedin or resume to find you roles. can't match you blind.

without knowing your actual background, skills, or how to reach you - there's no way to send you nutanix opportunities when they come up.

hit me up when you got a linkedin url or resume ready
https://www.linkedin.com/in/altafmallick?utm_source=share&utm_campaign=share_via&utm_content=profile&utm_medium=ios_app

got it, already have your profile from earlier. let me ask what i need to get you matched properly.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Fully remote or Kolkata or Mumbai
8 to 12 years and other thing is right
4 years total + nutanix admin/architecture + remote/kolkata/mumbai... sound right?

wait... 8-12 years? that's a massive jump from "nearly 4 years" you said earlier.

which is it? this makes a huge difference for what roles i can send you. senior nutanix architect positions vs mid-level admin roles are completely different ballgames.
Yes correct

alright so 8-12 years total experience, looking for nutanix admin/architecture roles, remote or kolkata or mumbai... sound right?

still need your linkedin or resume though. can't send you roles without knowing how to contact you or verify your background.
https://www.linkedin.com/in/altafmallick?utm_source=share&utm_campaign=share_via&utm_content=profile&utm_medium=ios_app
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

boom! you're in the system altaf.

8-12 years of nutanix wizardry, ready to escape the accenture matrix. remote or kolkata/mumbai - got it.

welcome to tal. now the real work begins.
Hi

hey altaf

what's good?
Hi

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?
